why: The launch-record adapter is a narrow cross-layer seam: it reads AppServices and WindowManager state, owns the FFI snapshot lifetime, and is called by WindowRecordSaver plus the quit hooks. Moving it to a new domain target requires a separate Host protocol and Package.swift slice; keeping this lifecycle wiring in the composition root lets the record writer land without changing launch behavior or adding a dependency edge.
